notes.title: Zardy's Cave Version 1.00.03 Update
notes.content:
Heya! We hope you’ve all been enjoying your spelunking so far! Zardy’s Cave Version 1.00.03 for Chapter 1 and the first 6 challenges is now live with a few minor updates and bug fixes!

Bugs:

- Fixed various softlock spots in Chapter 1
- Coyote time double jump fix
- Brute corn doll material fixed on pause screen
- Fixed collider issues in final challenge (missing boulder collider, stone columns)
- Cursor hidden during intro cutscenes
- Double Jack grab no longer breaks the game
- Jack mid air mantle fixed
- Zardy vanishes in challenge 5 now and won't camp the ledge

Updates:

- FOV slider option added (default was previously 60 vertical)
- Made vines paths wider in Chapter 1
- Fixed restriction animation hand clipping in room with pumpkins
- Sprint no longer disables after crouch sliding
- Made Jack a lil' less dumb (hint triggers added in Chapter 1)
- Manual axe pickup when it is stuck in the ground
- Unavailable UI element for currently unusable tools
- Jack is now enabled in Challenge 5 as soon as player lands in maze below

If you run into any issues, consider reporting the bug on our Discord channel or adding it to the community bug thread on Steam. In the meantime we'll be working on Chapter 2!

notes.title: Zardy's Cave Version 1.00.02 Update
notes.content:
Hello dwellers of the deep! We hope you’ve all been enjoying your spelunking so far! Zardy’s Cave Version 1.00.02 for Chapter 1 and the first 6 challenges is now live with a few minor updates and bug fixes!

Bugs:

- Fixed various softlock spots in Chapter 1
- Fixed unintended skybox breaking in opening cutscene on super wide displays
- Missing collider on wall in room with first seed tree in Chapter 1
- Prone speed no longer influenced by game FPS
- Display options no longer show duplicates
- Overlapping Jack bug that breaks camera system (still exploring edge cases)

Updates:

- Adjusted leaves and jumping platforms in middle section of final challenge for smoother mantling
- Spline vine in second Jack maze area raised near vine platform (Jack jump point cleared)
- Chapter 1 corn maze no longer randomized per death
- Locked door introduced earlier to teach people lock and key mechanic
- Locked doors added to Chapter 1 multi-seed puzzle room to guide player to seed plots before seeds
- Input prompts for controls added earlier on

If you run into any issues, consider reporting the bug on our Discord channel or adding it to the community bug thread on Steam.
